findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_pro_profile, get_pro · Private data: get_pro_profile, what_breaks, repair_cost, send_claim_link · Public sink: what_breaks, send_claim_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_pro_profile, get_pro · Private data: get_pro_profile, what_breaks, repair_cost, send_claim_link · Public sink: what_breaks, send_claim_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
